# CFOLogic

> CFOLogic is a full-stack finance partner for growth-focused businesses ($2-50M revenue): fractional CFO strategy, FP&A, controllership and finance operations (FinOps), delivered by senior finance leaders in the US backed by a 40+ person Center of Excellence in Pune, India. Services include CEO Navigator™ (full finance function for founder-led businesses), CFO Success Partners™ (execution capacity for sitting CFOs), Smart Dashboards, deal support, and white-label CAS capacity for CPA firms.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://cfologic.com/): Full-stack finance - CFO strategy, FP&A, controller and finance operations from one team
- [Finance Team as a Service](https://cfologic.com/finance-team-as-a-service): What FTaaS is, the four layers (FinOps, controller, FP&A, fractional CFO), the hybridshore delivery model (US-based leadership, India-based teams, high AI leverage), and a costed comparison against hiring in-house
- [For Founders & CEOs](https://cfologic.com/founders): CEO Navigator™ - the full finance pyramid as a service
- [For CFOs](https://cfologic.com/cfo-success-partners): CFO Success Partners™ - retained execution team for finance leaders
- [For CFO/CAS Firms](https://cfologic.com/accounting-firms): HybridShore capability for US CFO/CAS firms
- [For Acquisition Entrepreneurs](https://cfologic.com/acquisition-entrepreneurs): Diligence and deal support before the close; lender-ready finance, covenant and DSCR monitoring after
- [For Capital Providers](https://cfologic.com/capital-providers): Portfolio-wide Navigator reporting and an on-call CFO Success Partners™ bench for private credit funds, PE and search investors, and independent sponsors
- [Case Studies](https://cfologic.com/case-studies)
- [About](https://cfologic.com/about)
- [Trust Center](https://cfologic.com/trust-center): Security and data handling
